historical_results: All earlier failed reports, raw traces and scores remain unchanged; no response_source was backfilled into historical observations.
implemented: Bind each main response, action-contract rejection and durable feedback to trace, step, exact raw-text hash, generated call identity, returning route and terminal HTTP attempt. Snapshots are detached and concurrent calls cannot borrow shared last-response state.

Project only the allowlisted response_source into the next main-model context and preserve it through compaction and Memory/SQLite checkpoint recovery. Full diagnostics, raw malformed JSON and reasoning do not enter this projection.

Validate empty-source proof against explicit saved HTTP 200, complete body and JSON, original content existence/type/length, final ordered unique attempt and the actual fallback leaf. Every fallback wrapper must bind a failed primary; reject missing failure, mismatched identities, cross-branch reuse and broken nested routes.

Recovery oracle independently matches response, rejection, feedback, context and the last actually submitted prompt; it requires unique identities, safe rejection, later legal execution and tool feedback, final domain state and independent semantics. Empty/absent diagnostics cannot be supplemented from hidden in-memory string attributes. Other business, permission, privacy and semantic failures remain blocking.

Keep source metadata out of visible-review tool evidence and tool history while preserving original customer words and business facts. Stable deterministic identifier/field rules block accidental source leakage, including fullwidth and separated forms. No automatic HTTP retry of empty content or action-contract relaxation was added.
